"Hey Mama" is a song recorded by the French DJ and record producer David Guetta featuring singers Nicki Minaj and Bebe Rexha, and co-production by the Dutch record producer Afrojack.
The song was released on 16 March 2015, as the fourth single from Guetta's sixth studio album, Listen (2014).
It was produced by David Guetta, Afrojack, and Giorgio Tuinfort, who also wrote the song with Rexha, Minaj, Ester Dean, and Sean Douglas.
Listen is the sixth studio album by French DJ and record producer David Guetta.
Dynamite, Elliphant, Birdy, Jaymes Young, Sonny Wilson, Vassy, and Skylar Grey.

It also features additional production from Guetta's frequent collaborator Giorgio Tuinfort, Avicii, Afrojack, Nicky Romero, Showtek, and Stadiumx among others, with additional writing credits from Austin Bisnow, Jason Evigan, Julie Frost, and The-Dream among others.
